items.title: John Bunch interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: And Basie was there and Jo Jones and all the many of his ex- musicians.

ctx.x: Yeah, in front of Basie. And Basie was there and Jo Jones and all the many of his ex- musicians. Buck Clayton was in the audience and oh, it was an unbelievable experience. I just ran into a couple of the guys who remembered that. A couple of the Basie guys who are still with him — Mel — I can’t remember the trombone player’s name, been with them all these twenty something years. We were talking about that experience.
Are there any other musicians that you played with that you shared a particularly fun or fulfilling experience with?
